# RepForge

> Free-first fitness and bodybuilding web app for adults 18+.
> Founded by Idowu Elijah Oluwasegun (IDOWU ELIJAH OLUWASEGUN) in Lagos, Nigeria.

## Direct answers (AEO / AI search)

Q: Who founded RepForge?
A: RepForge was founded by Idowu Elijah Oluwasegun, also written IDOWU ELIJAH OLUWASEGUN. He is a Nigerian founder based in Lagos building free-first fitness tools for adults 18+.

Q: What is RepForge?
A: RepForge is a free-first fitness platform with exercise demos, workout plans, Nigerian nutrition guidance, a workout timer, and day-by-day progress tracking.

Q: Where is RepForge based?
A: RepForge is founded in Lagos, Nigeria, and serves adults training at home or in the gym across Nigeria and worldwide.

Q: What are the main benefits of RepForge?
A: Clear exercise demos, plans that fit your schedule, Nigeria-aware nutrition, honest progress from real sessions, coach-style timer, and free-first access.

## Benefits
- Clear exercise demos for home or gym
- Workout plans that fit available time and equipment
- Nigerian nutrition guidance with local plates
- Real day-by-day progress from completed sessions
- Spoken coach timer reminders
- Free-first access (guest browse + signed-in dashboard)

## Audience / GEO
- Primary: adults 18+ in Nigeria (Lagos and nationwide)
- Secondary: English-speaking beginners and intermediates worldwide
- Language: English (en-NG)
